title: Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate
system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate where controlled surface roughness (Ra 3.2-6.3 µm) improves adhesion of applied coatings or bonding agents. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides sufficient ductility for forming operations while maintaining the excellent corrosion resistance characteristic of CP titanium. This surface preparation is tailored for Lower exhaust plenum baffle plate. This rationale is driven by lower exhaust plenum baffle plate and fat life requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with SPC sampling
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for lower exhaust plenum application
commonFailures: Virtual leak from dead-leg threaded connections - remedied by VCR/Swagelok face-seal fittings — critical for lower exhaust plenum performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate compatible with fluorine-based process chemistries?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti has excellent resistance to NF₃, CF₄, SF₆, and other fluorine-based plasma chemistries used in semiconductor etching and chamber cleaning. The TiO₂ passive layer forms a stable TiF₄ reaction product that does not spall or generate particles. However, Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate should not be used in HF-containing wet processes where corrosion rates exceed 0.5 mm/year.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate?
faq.a: Each Titanium Exhaust Baffle Plate shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for lower exhaust plenum.
